notes.title: 2022.8.30 version update
notes.notes:
New content of part I:

1. Add a tunnel scene to save the game after the end of closing.



Part II gameplay adjustment and bug correction:

1. In the previous version, after the protagonist died in the community, the bug with lost weapons was not completely repaired. This must be seen bug has been repaired again.

2. Add the prompt after the annihilation of the community NPC yaeben to avoid the situation that the player gets stuck due to confusion.



While making the game, I have to work hard for life, so the progress is slow, but there are no abandoned pits. I also hope to complete it as soon as possible.

notes.title: 2021.4.10 Version update
notes.notes:
2021.4.10 version update

Part I new content:
1. Add pictures and random prompts when loading.

The second part is game adjustment and bug correction
1. Fixed the problem of community NPC blinking. This occasional bug has been fixed.
2-1 when the protagonist dies in the community, the weapon will be lost and cannot be picked up. This bug has been fixed.
2-2 when the protagonist dies in the community, NPC will appear repeatedly. This bug has been fixed.
3. Fixed the problem of wrong UI layer in some scenarios. This bug has been fixed.

Many players complain that there are few prompts, so the prompt is added when loading. On the one hand, it will not be so boring when loading, on the other hand, it can make players understand the game faster. I think it's just a small update, but I'm tired of doing it. Every little idea may contain unlimited workload. I hope what I do can give you a better experience.

notes.title: 20201231 version patch
notes.notes: If the old player has an archive in the old version, he will not read the new variable and make it empty without triggering the plot. It has been updated to solve this problem.

notes.title: Version update on December 31, 2020
notes.notes:
[b] I've kept you waiting for a long time. It's a whole year since the last version, but I feel that it's only one day. I finished this version on the last day of 2020. At the same time, I wish you a happy New Year!
[/b]

Version update on December 31, 2020

Part I new content:

1. Add community plots and scenes.
2. Add plots and scenes of suburban roads. (vehicle system level)
3. Add urban plots and scenes.

65% game completion



The second part is game adjustment and bug correction
1. Fixed the disorder of time and space in the bar and the revival of NPC. This bug has been fixed.
2. When snow mountain dies, there will be infinite circulation. This bug has been fixed.
3-1. The subway part has been integrated into the plot and is no longer listed as a test scenario.
3-2. The plot of the subway is slightly modified to make it more reasonable.
3-3. Metro NPC Angela will display tasks repeatedly. This bug has been fixed.
4. NPC follows the adjustment, and can't command it to move to the designated area at any time.
5. The snow mountain and the subway have joined the archive points.
6. Delete the option button in the menu bar, and the options will be made together with the UI after the functions are improved.
7. Increase the power of pistol. The damage of the previous version is obviously weaker than that of bow and arrow, which is unscientific.
